prompt.en: The Green Page is hiding down here. Can you find it?
prompt.ar: الصَّفْحَةُ الخَضْرَاءُ مُخْتَبِئَةٌ هُنَا فِي الأَسْفَل. هَلْ تَجِدُهَا؟

hint1.en: Look near the bottom, past the wide leaves.
hint1.ar: اُنْظُرْ قُرْبَ الأَسْفَل، خَلْفَ الأَوْرَاقِ العَرِيضَة.

hint2.en: It is green, and flat like paper.

model.en: There it is. Touch it and it is yours.

payload._comment: Positions are whole percentages of the scene box, so one authored scene works on a phone, a tablet and in landscape. Hidden-object scenes do NOT mirror in Arabic: a painted jungle is a picture, not a line of text. The clue art is `page_green.png` and not a coloured shape - the story calls this the GREEN page in both locales, and the previous art was `shapes/square.png`, which is orange. A child who is told to find something green and then hands back an orange square has been lied to, and hint2 ('it is green, and flat like paper') only works because the asset now actually is. A content test asserts the thing searched for and the thing awarded are one picture.
